title: Concept: Symfony exception trace disclosed in a response
description: Symfony debug pages print the exception chain with absolute file paths, the request attributes and frequently the arguments of the failing call. A public response that contains one therefore discloses the deployment layout and the data that reached the failure.
applicability: Responses generated by a Symfony application running with the debug kernel.
risk: The caller learns the deployment paths, the framework version and the argument values of the failing call, which supports both targeted injection and path discovery.
